held_out.separation_rule: A work node is held out only if it belongs to SCP-SI-01, whose 2026-08-27 frozen baseline states that no SCP-SI-01 output pre-existed. This cohort begins more than four days after the route table's last authoring commit. Earlier OE-W8/W9/W10 material is excluded even when its commit timestamp is later than the table, because commit order alone cannot prove that concurrently prepared work was absent from the author's context.

evaluation_contract.unit: one canonical route profile applied to one activated held-out task
evaluation_contract.selector: Route only when the profile itself establishes compatible direction, required content fidelity, a machine-readable return into repository custody, and every stated precondition in the observed held-out run. Otherwise abstain. A same-provider or same-product family is not the same route.
evaluation_contract.rate_rule: Rates are reported only with numerator and denominator. With fewer than 30 independent exercised decisions, the rate is explicitly NOT_ESTABLISHED and the percentage is omitted.
evaluation_contract.evidence_loss_rule: Count a loss only when an exercised route omitted a property listed in that task's required_return_properties and a downstream consumer demonstrably needed it.
evaluation_contract.recovery_rule: Recovery requires an observed corrective route or retry after a wrong route. A documented fallback that was not invoked is not recovery.
evaluation_contract.currentness_rule: Propagation succeeds only when the result reaches the audited integration/currentness projection. A lane-local commit is durable custody but not currentness propagation.

constraints.statement: Exclude every case that cannot be proved absent from profile authoring context.
constraints.defect_caught: CUR-ORCH-QUAL's producer register reported two qualified routes, but independent challenge later refused the aggregate and only R1 survived. Reusing qualification-era cases as held-out would repeat producer evidence as independent proof.

constraints.statement: A route profile abstains unless its own direction, fidelity and preconditions match the held-out work node.
constraints.defect_caught: The R23 evidence records that OE-W6 called the Cursor route absent after probing a guessed 404 path; explicit published-route evidence corrected that false absence.

constraints.statement: Do not report an established rate over this eight-node set.
constraints.quote: if your held-out set is too small to support a rate, report the raw counts and say the rate is not established — a percentage over four samples is theatre

constraints.statement: Keep route failure separate from inability to exercise a route.
constraints.quote: distinguish a route that failed from a route you could not exercise; UNESTABLISHED is a legitimate and useful finding

constraints.statement: A local lane result does not count as currentness propagation until the audited integration projection contains it.
constraints.defect_caught: The SCP-SI-01 baseline's first stale-base map produced five false NOT_FOUND results before the correct return-branch ref was restored.

per_route_count_schema.abstained: profile declined because direction, fidelity or a stated precondition was not established
per_route_count_schema.routed_correct: exact canonical route was exercised and delivered all required properties
per_route_count_schema.routed_wrong: exact canonical route was exercised, selected and wrong
per_route_count_schema.evidence_loss_events: exercised route omitted a property a consumer demonstrably needed
per_route_count_schema.retries: same exact route attempted again after an initial attempt
per_route_count_schema.currentness_propagations: result reached the audited integration/currentness projection

per_route.why: The OpenAI Responses API cannot read the SCP repository or commit its artifacts without a separate caller/return route; no Platform API-key route was observed.
API-native conversation containers preserve API calls, not repository work nodes or ChatGPT UI context, and the required Platform key was not established.
The profile's enumerated service connectors contain no GitHub connector, so they cannot return these repository-native tasks.
No admitted ChatGPT connector writing into this repository, founder session or per-service authorization was observed.
No ChatGPT developer-mode app or repository-writing remote MCP endpoint was present.
No tunnel id, tunnel client, durable host or tunnel credential was observed.
The profile explicitly says Workspace Agent trigger returns a conversation URL but not answer content; it cannot return any required artifact.
The profile returns status only and explicitly no content, so it correctly declines every held-out artifact task.
The default destination is a human inbox and no outward-writing connector or MCP app was observed.
Founder hardware, desktop-app, local-project and push preconditions were not observed; the cohort used isolated cloud worktrees instead.
Plan eligibility, admin authentication and the private contract were not established; an audit export is also not a repository result-return path by itself.
Codex Analytics returns aggregate metrics, not task content, executable artifacts, hashes or verdicts.
The canonical profile itself is UNESTABLISHED and the export is an owner act rather than a recurring machine route.
No Codex-to-GitHub connection or Codex environment was observed. GitHub branches returned by Cursor are not evidence that Codex R14 ran.
No Codex GitHub integration, automatic review or Codex-authored PR review was observed; no pull request was created for the observed returns.
No Codex GitHub Action workflow or authorized Platform-key invocation was observed.
Plan eligibility and a Codex access token were not established; the observed workers were Cursor Cloud Agents.
No ChatGPT service account, pay-as-you-go entitlement or service-account token was observed.
The route runs from Cursor into ChatGPT and carries no result toward the repository; it correctly abstains.
The founder's Chrome session was not involved and results would terminate in chat content rather than repository custody.
The profile is platform-incompatible with this Linux cloud runtime and returns chat-resident output, not structured repository artifacts.
No authenticated ChatGPT browser session or agent-facing Browser tool was exposed, and the held-out tasks did not require ChatGPT UI content.
The cohort source was internal and no Cursor REST API invocation or API key was observed. Internal Cursor MCP control is adjacent but is not the R23 REST route.
No GitHub @cursor comment, Slack trigger or Linear trigger was observed; internal cohort dispatch is not one of the profiled triggers.
No v0 webhook endpoint, signing secret or statusChange delivery was observed; direct MCP status reads are not webhook delivery.
No durable OpenAI webhook endpoint, event subscription or signing secret was observed; the route concerns Platform objects, not these repository tasks.
Cursor consumed MCP control tools, but R27 profiles calls to external tools, not a standalone task-result return. No external MCP server carrying a held-out result was exercised.

abstentions.why: Six task definitions share one repository-native return topology and are not 162 independent trials. A percentage would imply evidence the design does not contain.

aggregate.interpretation: Every canonical profile abstained under explicit direction/fidelity/precondition checks. Abstention is the correct conservative result, not a failure. Because no exact canonical route was selected, wrong-route performance and recovery are unestablished.

operational_control_route_observations.scope_note: These observations extend the preserved qualification context; they do not add route ids to the canonical 27-route table.

lost_evidence: artifact content was not returned by the exercised metadata call
R2-CURSOR-AGENT-CONTROL-MCP.consumer_need: HO-A required its structured remediation artifact and immutable return, not only an IDLE status.
R2-CURSOR-AGENT-CONTROL-MCP.why_not_failure: The exercised batch-details call returned metadata as specified, but did not establish the artifact/content retrieval half. No transcript was fetched because this Lane E run may not spawn the subagent required by the tool's transcript-reading discipline.

unprofiled_ingress_observation.observation: The six activated SCP-SI-01 workers report source=internal and branchName=null. This runtime binding is not the REST, @cursor, Slack or Linear ingress described by R23/R24.

conclusion.precise_reading: The 13 YES claims did not fail; none became an operationally selectable exact route for these held-out nodes. The held-out run therefore does not validate general routing proof. It validates conservative abstention and two uses of the separately qualified GitHub custody route, while the MCP metadata route lost consumer-needed detail and recovered through GitHub.
